# Fixture provenance

- properties.xml: original user attachment from the referenced conversation, unchanged.
- levels.xml: normalized transcription of the 72-row response in the conversation.
- spaces.xml: observed response from the conversation.
- system.html: synthetic test page.
- system_observed_text.html: reconstructed HTML using visible text from the real System screenshot; NOT captured raw HTML.

No test contacts a physical CEM3.
